description_en: Queries the details of a specified external agent
description_zh: 查询指定外部智能体的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore get-external-agent --workspace-id ws-1 --agent-id agent-1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetExternalAgent

schema.description_en: The successful response for querying an external agent
schema.description_zh: 查询外部智能体的成功响应

code.description_en: The business status code. The value is SUCCESS if the request is successful
code.description_zh: 业务状态码。成功时为 SUCCESS

data.description_en: The details of the external agent

configuredSkills.description_en: Includes only the skills added or overridden by the user, excluding inherited items from templates. The resource model reads this field to preserve update semantics. Creation and update operations still use the skills in the request
configuredSkills.description_zh: 仅包含用户追加或覆盖的 Skill，不包含模板继承项。资源模型读取此字段以保留更新语义；创建和更新仍使用请求中的 skills

name.description_en: The name of the skill in the Workspace AI Registry
name.description_zh: Workspace AI Registry 中的 Skill 名称
name.title_en: Workspace AI Registry 中的 Skill 名称
name.title_zh: Workspace AI Registry 中的 Skill 名称

sourceType.description_en: The source type of the skill. Valid values: REFERENCE (references the AI Registry) and STATIC (statically provided with the package)
sourceType.description_zh: Skill 来源类型：REFERENCE 引用 AI Registry、STATIC 随包静态提供
sourceType.title_en: Skill 来源类型：REFERENCE 引用 AI Registry、STATIC 随包静态提供
sourceType.title_zh: Skill 来源类型：REFERENCE 引用 AI Registry、STATIC 随包静态提供

versionSelector.description_zh: 引用的版本选择器，省略时为 LABEL/latest；本期支持 LABEL/latest

type.description_en: The type of the version selector. Valid values: LABEL (selects by tag) and VERSION (selects by specific version)
type.description_zh: 版本选择器类型：LABEL 按标签、VERSION 按具体版本

value.description_en: The value of the selector. If the type is LABEL, the value is a tag name such as latest. If the type is VERSION, the value is a specific version number

value.title_en: 选择器取值：LABEL 时为标签名（如 latest），VERSION 时为具体版本号

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in RFC 3339 format

description.description_en: The description of the external agent
description.example: 运行在用户环境中的代码评审智能体

externalAgentStatus.description_en: The running status information reported by the external agent
externalAgentStatus.description_zh: 外部智能体上报的运行状态信息

heartbeatStatus.description_en: The heartbeat status. ONLINE indicates that the most recent heartbeat did not exceed the configured timeout threshold. STALE indicates that the heartbeat has timed out. UNKNOWN indicates that the heartbeat is missing or the format is invalid. Valid values: ONLINE (online), STALE (heartbeat expired), and UNKNOWN (unknown)
heartbeatStatus.description_zh: 心跳状态。ONLINE 表示最近心跳未超过配置的超时阈值；STALE 表示心跳已超时；UNKNOWN 表示心跳缺失或格式无效。枚举值：ONLINE（在线）、STALE（心跳过期）、UNKNOWN（未知）

lastActiveAt.description_en: The last active time of the external agent in RFC 3339 format
lastActiveAt.description_zh: 外部智能体最近一次活跃时间，RFC 3339 格式

lastHeartbeat.description_en: The last heartbeat time of the external agent in RFC 3339 format
lastHeartbeat.description_zh: 外部智能体最近一次心跳时间，RFC 3339 格式

localIP.description_en: The local IP address reported by the external agent
localIP.description_zh: 外部智能体上报的本地 IP 地址

runtime.description_en: The runtime type reported by the external agent
runtime.description_zh: 外部智能体上报的运行时类型

instruction.description_en: The agent instruction used to guide the behavior of the agent
instruction.description_zh: 智能体指令，用于指导智能体的行为
instruction.example: 你是一个代码评审助手

latestVersionStatus.description_en: The processing status of the latest specification version. Valid values: pending (pending), processing (processing), waiting_retry (waiting for retry), succeeded (succeeded), failed (failed), and superseded (superseded by a new version)
latestVersionStatus.description_zh: 最新规格版本的处理状态。枚举值：pending（待处理）、processing（处理中）、waiting_retry（等待重试）、succeeded（成功）、failed（失败）、superseded（已被新版本取代）

model.description_en: The model configuration. This field is available only when modelSource is set to PLATFORM
model.description_zh: 模型配置。仅 modelSource 为 PLATFORM 时可用

modelName.description_en: The name of the upstream model

quota.description_en: The model token quota configuration and usage status for the current period. This field is empty if no quota is configured
quota.description_zh: 模型 Token 配额配置及当前周期的配额使用状态；未配置配额时为空

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether the quota is enabled. This field is not returned if no quota is configured
enabled.description_zh: 配额是否处于启用状态；未配置配额时不返回
enabled.title_en: 配额是否处于启用状态；未配置配额时不返回
